generator_assessments.assessment: The presence of small round blue cells and positive immunohistochemistry for MyoD1 and myogenin are characteristic of rhabdomyosarcoma.

raw_support_spans.text: Papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia, edema of dermal papillae, and neoplastic infiltration consisting of small round blue cells with alternating areas of dense and loose cellularity
Small, round blue cells in the dermis with round, fusiform, or oval hyperchromatic nuclei, conspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm
Positive for MyoD1, myogenin, vimentin, and desmin
